scope: Stable verbose outcome lines and terminal summaries from chunk-03.log, chunk-04.log and chunk-05.log; exit codes from their JSON command records.

04.termination: Stopped early with worker restart disabled (parent classification)

method: Counted uppercase outcome lines attached to verbose test nodes, excluding repeated final failure listings. Reported counts match each terminal summary. Collected counts are the item-count mentions in each stable log. Collection is not execution coverage.
attribution: This audit does not attribute failures to the change. Isolation results are recorded separately by the parent.
source_review: The prior final source/test/contract diff review found no outstanding concrete concern. This results audit did not modify source or run tests.

read_only_commands.result: Located the three stable log/JSON pairs.

read_only_commands.command: python3 heredoc: read the three chunk logs; strip ANSI; count verbose PASSED/FAILED/ERROR/SKIPPED/XFAIL/XPASS node lines; extract failed/error nodes and terminal summaries; read exit_code from the corresponding JSON records.
read_only_commands.result: 38, 95 and 335 verbose outcomes, matching terminal summaries; exact nodes and exits recorded above.

read_only_commands.command: python3 heredoc: search the three logs for worker collection headers, collected-item headers, '^\[gw\d+\]\s+node down:' events, crash-limit markers and interrupt markers.
read_only_commands.result: 0, 2 and 1 node-down events. All three logs contain interrupt markers; no crash-limit marker. The initial bracketed collection-header expressions did not match the log format.

read_only_commands.command: python3 heredoc: extract '(?<![A-Za-z])(\d+)\s+items?\b' mentions from the three logs and list metadata keys without printing command/environment values.
read_only_commands.result: Collected counts 1144, 1989 and 2856; each metadata record has command, exit_code, finished and started keys.

outstanding_evidence_note: The earlier scratch-only diagnostic scanned 283 chunk-01 and 310 chunk-02 daemon logs (593 total), found no AF_UNIX/path-length/address/sandbox markers, and found only permission/OSError/timeout markers in refusal and retention tests. Socket bind can fail before a daemon log exists, so that scan cannot rule out setup-time socket-length failures. No process inspection, tests or writes occurred in that diagnostic. Its requested import-audit append was not performed before the later write restriction limited this final task to this new JSON file.
